notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Bug fixes / specification changes

 Change score calculation
Before change: The multiplier value is uniformly reduced by 10% when destroying an enemy
After change: The multiplier value is reduced by 5% when part is destroyed or when the form is changed, and reduced by 10% when the main body is destroyed
 Increase raw points for each boss part (except mid-bosses)
 Changed so that Tank-chan that appears in each stage moves
 Changed enemy appearance pattern in Stage 2
 Partially changed the contents of the manual and tutorial

Function addition

 Added a new enemy Gunship-chan to Stage 2
 Added a new enemy Fighter-chan to Stage 3 (under development)

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Bug fixes/specification changes

Fixed a bug where the previously saved VSync setting was not reflected when the game was started.
Change the default value to Disabled when VSync is not set
Fixed a bug when restarting after opening the pause menu after selecting the continue dialog

Function addition

Set BGM for Stage 2
Stage 3 under development can be played from Practice



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43195374/a34bac8642df41f6cdefcb50e538090b916246e1.png
I like 1UP Battleship. And you too.

notes.title: Additional functions
notes.content:
Added function to switch vertical sync.
TitleScene > Options > VSync

If the refresh rate exceeds 60, please change it to Disabled.
However, screen flickering may occur.

notes.title: Notice of resumption of development
notes.content:
I sincerely apologize for the lack of notification that development was temporarily suspended.
Development was temporarily suspended due to personal circumstances in the developer's real life, but since the problem was resolved, development will resume.
I apologize for the inconvenience this time.

I have just updated it a little.
Fixed behavior when starting Stage 3 in Practice Mode.
It no longer exits immediately, instead transitioning to a temporary stage.
On the temporary stage, you can play with Cruiser-chan.

notes.title: Additional functions
notes.content:
Added a function to switch display settings for each gadget.
TitleScene > Options > GadgetSettings
